name: edge-webmaster
description: Self-hosted code-mode MCP server for webmaster tools (Google Search Console, GA4, Bing Webmaster, PageSpeed/CrUX) on Cloudflare Workers

scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env="" && wrangler deploy --env=""

DEPLOYMENT_SECRET.description: Random 32-byte secret that wraps stored upstream credentials (AES-GCM) in D1. Set with: wrangler secret put DEPLOYMENT_SECRET

SETUP_TOKEN.description: Generate a separate random 32-byte secret. After deployment, unlock the dashboard and open **Agent access** for guided Cloudflare Access setup. [Installation guide](https://github.com/tannerwj/edge-webmaster/blob/master/DEPLOY.md#give-an-agent-access)

DB.description: Settings, agent tokens, audit log, MCP call metrics and the response cache. Migrations run with wrangler d1 migrations apply.

LOADER.description: Dynamic Worker loader used to sandbox code-mode execute calls.
